thread:
emily: Heads-up — AptlyHealth onboarding call just finished. They surfaced 3 concrete asks that feel like potential renewal blockers if we don't act: 1) per-route billing visibility in the Console (they need to show engineering teams cost by endpoint), 2) a lightweight embedding cost estimator for pilot planning, and 3) a toggle to disable prefix/KV caching for live demos. Also flagged two onboarding pain points: VPC/private deploy docs are out of date and our UI rate-limit messaging during spike tests is confusing.

claire: ack, thanks for the summary. can you paste the client quotes? we should tag this as renewal-risk and record in tracker. :eyes:

emily: sure — snippets below from the call: "we can't justify rollout unless we can show per-route spend to finance"; "our pilot team needs a quick cost calc for embeddings per 1M tokens"; "during demo caching made latency inconsistent". adding them to the sheet now.

sam: thanks. which of the three are actual blockers vs nice-to-have? I want to propose a prioritization for product.

emily: per-route billing = blocker (finance gating rollout). embedding estimator = blocker for pilot sizing. caching toggle = medium (workaround is not ideal but demoable). docs + rate-limit messaging = high friction but operational.

raj: noted. i can pick up per-route billing and the estimator as a paired deliverable — has overlap with per-route metering. need example acceptance criteria though.

emily: rough ACs (pasteable):
```
- Per-route billing: console shows cost broken down by route id/name for last 30d, exportable CSV, and API endpoint to query per-route totals.
- Embedding estimator: UI widget + API that takes tokens/embeddings-per-call and returns estimated monthly cost at selected commit/throughput.
- Caching toggle: admin flag to disable prefix/KV caching per deployment for 1hr window.
```

maya: enablement note — I can rework the demo playbook and script to avoid caching surprises and add a quick explain on per-route reporting. give me the doc link and i'll draft before EOD. :memo:

claire: apt — i'll reach out to the AptlyHealth CSM to confirm renewal window and share these ACs. adding to our renewal playbook entry: https://redwood.internal/docs/renewal-playbook#aptly (placeholder).

feedback-bot: created ticket PROD-7834 "Per-route billing view" assigned to @raj, label: renewal-risk, priority: P1.

sam: raj — can you do a quick spike to surface feasibility and an estimate? if it's >10 dev days we should consider a smaller scope (CSV + API first).

raj: spike started. initial read: backend metering already tags route ids, front-end view needs a lightweight aggregation endpoint. estimate: 5 dev days + 2 QA for minimal MVP (CSV + API + list view). full per-route dashboard ~3w.

emily: perfect. i'll call out the minimal MVP to the customer so expectations align.

maya: doc link for enablement draft: https://redwood.internal/enablement/demo-playbooks/aptly-draft — i'll put a checklist for the caching toggle workaround.

claire: i'm adding a line to the account health sheet: 
`AptlyHealth — renewal at risk; blockers: per-route billing (P1), embedding estimator (P1); owner: raj; CS owner: claire; action: spike by 1766667000`

sam: moving to triage board now. can we capture a short feature ask payload for product inbox? emily, can you add a single-line ask we can forward to PM tracking?

emily: pasted single-line ask to inbox: "Per-route billing view (exportable CSV + API) so finance can allocate spend by endpoint — blocker for rollout. AptlyHealth pilot."

feedback-bot: added to product-inbox as ITEM-1291, tags: [onboarding, billing, renewal-risk].

raj: i'll aim to have the spike summary + rough plan by EOD tomorrow.

emily: thanks all — i'll follow up after CSM sync and post any customer-provided examples. :pray: 

claire: thumbs up. we'll keep renewal playbook updated and flag in next weekly acct-health sync. :thumbsup:
